column1: # Purpose: mechanical guard that FAILS if a listed entry point has no mapped
# test file that exists on disk. This catches the class of P0 gap where a
# security-sensitive CLI/service ships with no test coverage at all.
# Checked by `qci selftest` via ci/bin/check-entrypoint-inventory.sh (which is
# invoked from gate_selftest in qci). The check is ADDITIVE and BACKWARD-
# COMPATIBLE: it only fails when a listed entry point's test_file is absent.
# Adding a new row never breaks existing CI; removing a row narrows the guard
# (don't do that without a reviewer sign-off).
#   entry_point    repo-relative path to the CLI/service script or binary
#   test_file      repo-relative path to >=1 test file that covers this entry point
#   why_sensitive  brief free-text rationale (for humans; not parsed)
# All entry-points listed here have tests as of the post-P0 state (2026-06-11).
# The manifest reflects CURRENT reality: the P0 gaps are now covered.

column3: Credential retrieval CLI: runs as user, must enforce broker approval before returning any secret
Credential retrieval CLI: negative path (denial) must propagate; a silent fail would leak secrets
Password daemon holds the vault unlock key; key derivation and storage must be correct
Password daemon must audit every unlock attempt
Password daemon uses polkit for privilege check; bypass = credential leak
PIN stash holds user-derived key material; incorrect storage/retrieval leaks credentials
TPM-backed key sealing: incorrect PCR binding allows unsealing on untrusted boot state
Media exec client: executes binaries in the silo context; argv injection = privilege escalation
Media exec client bridge: cross-silo media launch, must validate source silo identity
qsu (qdistro-sudo): runs commands as another user; bypass = privilege escalation
Root exec helper used by qsu; direct escalation path
Native-messaging host between browser extension and broker; injection = cross-origin data exfil
Browser bridge client: sends requests on behalf of browser; must authenticate the extension
Silo launch CLI: starts/stops containerised silos; wrong arity = silent stop failure
Admin broker: the central policy decision point for all qdistro actions
Admin broker: AVC recording path; mis-attribution = wrong silo blamed for a deny
audispd plugin parser: processes UNTRUSTED kernel audit input; crash = silent audit loss
VM silo manifest schema validator: fail-open = unauthorized guest service activation
